# setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
setup_dir <- normalizePath("../setup", mustWork = TRUE)
source(file.path(setup_dir, "setup.R"), local = TRUE)
plots_list <- list()
sample <- "vhio136"
batch_dir <- file.path(datapath, sample, "rootpath")
```

# load

Estimation of ambient RNA contamination using SoupX:
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/SoupX/vignettes/pbmcTutorial.html>
<https://www.sc-best-practices.org/preprocessing_visualization/quality_control.html>
<https://cellgeni.github.io/notebooks/html/new-10kPBMC-SoupX.html>

SoupX is used as a QC step only: the contamination fraction (rho) is estimated per sample, but counts are not corrected (no adjustCounts()), so the downstream object is built from the uncorrected matrix. autoEstCont() relies on cluster-specific genes, which are scarce in sorted T cells, so the estimate is fragile; forceAccept = TRUE only prevents the run from stopping when an implausible value is estimated. Estimated rho = 0.01 in all samples except post2_d42_pd1 (0.60), which SoupX itself flags as a failure of the estimation rather than real contamination.

```{r}
folder_data <- "rootpath"
object_files <- list.files(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data))
object_tags <- c("post2_bulk1", "post2_bulk2", "post2_bulk3", "post2_pd1", "pre_bulk1", "pre_bulk2", "pre_bulk3", "pre_pd1")
object_RP <- list()
soupX_RP <- list()
for (i in seq_along(object_files)) {
  toc <- Read10X(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files[i], "sample_filtered_feature_bc_matrix"))
  toc <- toc$`Gene Expression`
  toc_seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(toc)
  object_RP[[as.character(object_files[i])]] <- toc_seurat
  object_RP[[as.character(object_files[i])]]$tag <- paste0(object_tags[i], "_")
  tod <- Read10X(file.path(datapath_load, folder_data, object_files[i], "raw_feature_bc_matrix"))
  tod <- tod$`Gene Expression`
  sc <- SoupChannel(tod, toc)
  toc_seurat <- PercentageFeatureSet(toc_seurat, pattern = "^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")
  set.seed(SEED)
  toc_seurat <- SCTransform(toc_seurat, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE, seed.use = 1448145)
  toc_seurat <- RunPCA(toc_seurat, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- RunTSNE(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- RunUMAP(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, seed.use = SEED)
  toc_seurat <- FindNeighbors(toc_seurat, dims = 1:10, verbose = FALSE)
  toc_seurat <- FindClusters(toc_seurat, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 1.2, random.seed = SEED)
  DefaultAssay(toc_seurat) <- "RNA"
  meta <- toc_seurat@meta.data
  umap <- toc_seurat@reductions$umap@cell.embeddings
  sc <- setClusters(sc, setNames(meta$seurat_clusters, rownames(meta)))
  sc <- setDR(sc, umap)
  set.seed(SEED)
  sc  <- autoEstCont(sc, forceAccept = TRUE)
  soupX_RP[[as.character(object_files[i])]] <- sc
  rm(toc, toc_seurat, tod, sc, meta, umap, soup, i)
}
dir.create(file.path(batch_dir, "seurat"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(soupX_RP, file.path(batch_dir, "seurat", "soupX_rootpath.rds"))
rm(object_files, object_tags)
```

IC01 - Gene contribution to the SoupX.

```{r}
plots_soupX <- list()
for (i in names(soupX_RP)) {
  data_i <- head(soupX_RP[[i]]$soupProfile[order(soupX_RP[[i]]$soupProfile$est, decreasing = TRUE), ], n = 50)
  data_i$gene <- as.character(row.names(data_i))
  data_i$gene <- factor(data_i$gene, levels = data_i$gene)
  data_i$source <- ifelse(grepl("^MT-", data_i$gene), "mito",
                  ifelse(grepl("^RPS|^RPL", data_i$gene), "ribo", "other"))
  plot_i <- ggplot(data_i, aes(x = gene, y = est, fill = source)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    ylim(0, 0.13) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(source == "other", as.character(gene), "")), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5, angle = 45) +
    labs(title = i, x = NULL, y = "soupX est") +
    theme_ic +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio = 0.5)
  plots_soupX[[as.character(i)]] <- plot_i
}
plots_list[["IC01_soupX"]] <- wrap_plots(plots_soupX, ncol = length(names(soupX_RP)) / 2)
rm(soupX_RP, plots_soupX, i, data_i, plot_i)
```

Tag each sample by time, enrichment and sample.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
post2 <- c(names[grep("post2", names)])
cd3 <- c(names[grep("bulk", names)])
for (i in names) {
  object_RP[[i]]$sample <- i
  object_RP[[i]]$time <- ifelse(i %in% post2, "post2", "pre")
  object_RP[[i]]$enrichment <- ifelse(i %in% cd3, "bulk", "pd1")
  object_RP[[i]]$batch <- "RP"
  rownames <- rownames(object_RP[[i]]@meta.data)
  rownames <- paste0(object_RP[[i]]@meta.data$tag, rownames)
  rownames(object_RP[[i]]@meta.data) <- rownames
  names(object_RP[[i]]@active.ident) <- rownames
  rownames(object_RP[[i]]@assays$RNA@cells@.Data) <- rownames
  rm(rownames, i)
}
rm(post2, cd3, names)
```

IC04 - Quality of cells with high MT and RBP content.

```{r}
metadata <- object@meta.data
metrics <- c("percent.mt", "percent.rpl", "percent.rps", "percent.rpa")
qc_curves <- list()
for (i in metrics) {
  thresholds <- seq(0, 70, by = 1)
  results <- data.frame(threshold = numeric(), passing_cells = numeric(), tag_data = character())
  for (j in unique(metadata$tag)) {
    tag_data <- metadata[metadata$tag == j, ]
    for (k in thresholds) {
      percent_passing <- mean(tag_data[[i]] <= k)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(threshold = k, passing_cells = percent_passing, tag = j))
      results$tag <- factor(results$tag, levels = c("pre_bulk1", "pre_bulk2", "pre_bulk3", "pre_pd1", "post2_bulk1", "post2_bulk2", "post2_bulk3", "post2_pd1"))
    }
  }
  plot_i <- ggplot(results, aes(x = threshold, y = passing_cells, color = tag, fill = tag)) +
    geom_line() +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired") +
    labs(title = i, x = paste0("max_", i), y = "percent_passing_filter") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, by = 10)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) +
    theme_ic +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          aspect.ratio = 1)
  if (i == "percent.mt") {
    plot_i <- plot_i +
      geom_vline(xintercept = c(10), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.3)
  }
  qc_curves[[i]] <- plot_i
}
plots_list[["IC04_qc_mt"]] <- wrap_plots(qc_curves, ncol = 2)
print(plots_list$IC04_qc_mt)
rm(metadata, metrics, qc_curves, i, j, k, thresholds, results, tag_data, percent_passing, plot_i)
```

Tag cells between 10-20% percent.mt to check where they fall in the umap.

Eliminating the 10-20% will affect the samples from batch1 (rootpath) more than those from batch2 (vhio). First, the 20% will be considered and where they fall will be evaluated.

```{r}
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt > 20, "elim_mt", NA)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt >= 15 & object$percent.mt <= 20, "high_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt >= 10 & object$percent.mt < 15, "int_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- ifelse(object$percent.mt < 10, "low_mt", object$tag.mt)
object$tag.mt <- factor(object$tag.mt, levels = c("elim_mt", "low_mt", "int_mt", "high_mt"))
mt_table <- table(object$tag.mt, object$tag)
print(mt_table)
rm(mt_table)
```

# filtering

Elimination of cells with >20% percent.mt and without TCR info + genes detected in <5 cells.
TCR V(D)J and ribosomal genes are kept in the matrix (they contribute to library size and normalization). They are excluded downstream: from integration (genes.blacklist.default in STACAS) and from DE/signatures (excluded_signature_genes() in setup/functions.R).

```{r}
counts <- GetAssayData(object = object, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
expressed_genes <- rowSums(counts > 0) >= 5
keep_genes <- names(expressed_genes[expressed_genes])
all_cells <- rownames(object@meta.data)
elim_cells_mt <- all_cells[object@meta.data$tag.mt == "elim_mt"]
elim_cells_tcr <- all_cells[object@meta.data$tag.tcr == "no"]
keep_cells <- setdiff(all_cells, c(elim_cells_mt, elim_cells_tcr))
object <- subset(object,
                 features = keep_genes,
                 cells = keep_cells
                 )
rm(counts, expressed_genes, keep_genes, all_cells, elim_cells_mt, elim_cells_tcr, keep_cells)
```

IMPORTANT: Repeat IC04 and IC05 quality checks after filtering.

# doublets

Automated annotation using scDblFinder:
<https://github.com/plger/scDblFinder?tab=readme-ov-file>
<https://plger.github.io/scDblFinder/articles/scDblFinder.html>

```{r, warning=FALSE}
set.seed(SEED)
# --- Transform Seurat to SCE ---
sce_obj <- as.SingleCellExperiment(object, assay = "RNA")
colData(sce_obj)$tag <- object$tag
sce_obj <- scDblFinder(
  sce_obj,
  samples = "tag",
  clusters = FALSE,
  BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = SEED)
)
# --- Return to Seurat ---
object$scDblFinder.score <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.score
object$scDblFinder.class <- sce_obj$scDblFinder.class
table(object$scDblFinder.class)
rm(sce_obj)
```

IC06 - Correlation between scDblFinder and number of TCRB sequences.

There are cells that scDblFinder does not identify as doublets. However, this could be corrected by eliminating cells with two TCRB sequences, as they also have a high expression of TRBV.avg.

```{r}
doublet_plots <- ggplot(
  object@meta.data,
  aes(x = logreads, y = scDblFinder.score, color = scDblFinder.class)
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(~tag) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "doublet" = "#FF5A1F",
      "singlet" = "#355070"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Doublets",
    x = "logreads",
    y = "scDblFinder score",
    color = "scDblFinder class"
  ) +
  theme_ic
plots_list[["IC06_qc_doublets_tcrb"]] <- doublet_plots
print(plots_list$IC06_qc_doublets_tcrb)
rm(doublet_plots)
```

Important: Keep those clonotypes included in the TCR library.

```{r}
tcr_lib_clonotypes <- readRDS(file.path(aux_dir, "tcr-library", "tcr_library_clonotypes_pre_post2.rds")) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  distinct(cdr3,
           v_gene,
           j_gene,
           .keep_all = TRUE)
tcr_lib_clonotypes$key <- paste(tcr_lib_clonotypes$cdr3, tcr_lib_clonotypes$v_gene, tcr_lib_clonotypes$j_gene, sep = "_")
object@meta.data$key <- paste(object@meta.data$cdr3, object@meta.data$v_gene, object@meta.data$j_gene, sep = "_")
match_idx <- match(object@meta.data$key,
                   tcr_lib_clonotypes$key)
object@meta.data$id <- tcr_lib_clonotypes$id[match_idx]
object@meta.data$key <- NULL
```

Doublet removal.

```{r}
object <- subset(object, subset = scDblFinder.class != "doublet" | !is.na(object$id))
```

# SCTransform

<https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/sctransform_vignette>

```{r}
set.seed(SEED)
object_SCT <- SCTransform(object, vars.to.regress = "percent.mt", verbose = FALSE, return.only.var.genes = FALSE, seed.use = 1448145)
object_SCT <- RunPCA(object_SCT, verbose = FALSE, seed.use = SEED)
ElbowPlot(object_SCT, reduction = "pca")
ndim <- 6
object_SCT <- RunTSNE(object_SCT, dims = 1:ndim, seed.use = SEED)
object_SCT <- RunUMAP(object_SCT, dims = 1:ndim, seed.use = SEED)
object_SCT <- FindNeighbors(object_SCT, dims = 1:ndim, verbose = FALSE)
object_SCT <- FindClusters(object_SCT, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.75, random.seed = SEED)
rm(ndim)
```

g <- list()
for (i in seq_along(features)) {

  }
plots_list[["IC07_qc_parameters"]] <- marrangeGrob(grobs= g, nrow=2, ncol=5)
rm(features, g, i)

IC08 - Quality control plots by cluster.

```{r, warning=FALSE}
t <- data.frame(sample_type= object_SCT@meta.data$tag,
                logreads = object_SCT@meta.data$logreads,
                percent.mt = object_SCT@meta.data$percent.mt,
                RPA = object_SCT@meta.data$percent.rpa,
                clusters= object_SCT@meta.data$seurat_clusters)

g1 <- ggplot(t, aes(x = logreads, y = RPA)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = percent.mt), alpha = 0.5,size = 0.8) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "H") +
  geom_density_2d(aes(color = percent.mt), alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ clusters) + geom_vline(xintercept = 8, lty=2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, lty=2) +
  theme_ic +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
g2 <- DimPlot(object_SCT, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = T) +
  theme_ic +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plots_list[["IC08_qc_clusters"]] <- wrap_plots(g1, g2, ncol = 2)
rm(g1, g2)
```

# magic

```{r}
# --- Perform MAGIC imputation and integrate imputed expression values ---
genes_magic <- c(
  "CD4", "CD8A", "CD8B", "PDCD1", "ENTPD1", "CXCL13",
  "CD69", "TNFRSF9", "ICOS", "TNFRSF4",
  "NR4A1", "FOS", "JUNB", "EGR1", "NFKBIA",
  "IFNG", "CD38", "HLA-DRA",
  "IL2RA", "CD40LG"
)
sct_data <- SeuratObject::LayerData(object_SCT, assay = "SCT", layer = "data")
genes_missing <- setdiff(genes_magic, rownames(sct_data))
if (length(genes_missing)) warning("Genes not found within the SCT assay: ", paste(genes_missing, collapse = ", "))
genes_magic <- intersect(genes_magic, rownames(sct_data))
if (!length(genes_magic)) stop("None of the selected genes were found within the SCT assay.")
graph_genes <- intersect(unique(c(SeuratObject::VariableFeatures(object_SCT[["SCT"]]), genes_magic)), rownames(sct_data))
npca_magic <- min(10L, length(graph_genes) - 1L, ncol(sct_data) - 1L)
if (npca_magic < 2L) stop("There are not enough genes or cells to run MAGIC.")
magic_data <- t(as.matrix(Rmagic::magic(
  data = t(sct_data[graph_genes, , drop = FALSE]),
  genes = genes_magic,
  npca = npca_magic,
  n.jobs = as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", unset = "1")),
  verbose = FALSE,
  seed = SEED
)$result))
magic_data <- magic_data[genes_magic, colnames(object_SCT), drop = FALSE]
object_SCT@meta.data[, paste0(genes_magic, "_mag")] <- t(magic_data[, rownames(object_SCT@meta.data), drop = FALSE])
rm(sct_data, magic_data, graph_genes, genes_missing, npca_magic)
gc()
```

# pdfCluster.

The distribution of magic expression of CD4 and CD8A genes is used to define the thresholds for designating a cell as CD4+ or CD8+ T cell.

```{r}
pdfcluster_plots <- list()
n_per_sample <- 750
sample_var <- object_SCT@meta.data$tag
idx_list <- split(seq_along(sample_var), sample_var)
idx_selected <- unlist(lapply(idx_list, function(idx) {
  idx[seq_len(min(n_per_sample, length(idx)))]
}), use.names = FALSE)
```

Distribution of CD4_mag expression.

```{r}
set.seed(PDFCLUSTER_CD4_SEED)
sc <- object_SCT@meta.data$CD4_mag[idx_selected]
pd <- pdfCluster(sc, hmult = 0.75)
summary(pd)
cl <- groups(pd)
names(cl) <- names(sc)
table(cl)
tapply(sc, cl, summary)
dens <- density(sc)
pdfcluster_plots[["CD4"]] <- {
  grid.newpage()
  dens <- density(sc)
  plot(dens, main = "CD4_mag", ylim = c(-0.005, max(dens$y)))
  abline(v = tapply(sc, cl, min)[-1], lty = 3, lwd = 2, col = "gray")
  abline(v = tapply(sc, cl, max)[-1], lty = 3, lwd = 2, col = "gray")
  abline(h = c(-0.001, -0.005))
  text(x = sc[cl == 1], y = -0.001, col = "green3", label = "|")
  text(x = sc[cl == 2], y = -0.005, col = "red3", label = "|")
  text(x = sc[cl == 3], y = -0.005, col = "purple", label = "|")
  recordPlot()
}
x <- tapply(sc, cl, min)
x_sorted <- sort(x, na.last = NA)
thresholdCD4 <- x_sorted[2]
rm(sc, pd, cl, dens, x, x_sorted)
```

Table of summary results.

```{r}
props <- do.call(rbind,lapply(levels(object_SCT@meta.data$seurat_clusters), function(k){
    y <- t[t$clusters==k,]
    CD8 <- sum(y$CD8A>thresholdCD8 & y$CD4<thresholdCD4 & !(y$logreads<8 & y$RPA<20 & y$percent.mt > 15))
    CD4 <- sum(y$CD8A<thresholdCD8 & y$CD4>thresholdCD4 & !(y$logreads<8 & y$RPA<20 & y$percent.mt > 15))
    others <- nrow(y)-CD8-CD4
    c(CD8,CD4,others)
}))
colnames(props) <-  c("CD8","CD4","others")
df <- data.frame(clusters =levels(object_SCT@meta.data$seurat_clusters), props)
df$byclust <- "none"
df[df[,2]/apply(df[,-c(1,5)],1,sum)>0.6,"byclust"] <- "CD8"
df[df[,3]/apply(df[,-c(1,5)],1,sum)>0.6,"byclust"] <- "CD4"
df$diffCD4CD8 <- apply(df[,c(2,3)],1,min)/apply(df[,c(2,3)],1,max)*100
df$diffMaxOthers <- df[,c(4)]/apply(df[,c(2,3)],1,max)*100
rt1 <- df
rm(props, df)
```

Designate CD4+ or CD8+ T cell in the Seurat object.

```{r}
rt2 <- data.frame(class= c("CD4","CD8","none"),
           ind.method = c(sum(object_SCT$CD4ind), sum(object_SCT$CD8ind), sum(!object_SCT$CD8ind & !object_SCT$CD4ind)),
           clust.method = c(sum(object_SCT$CD4indbyclust),sum(object_SCT$CD8indbyclust), sum(!object_SCT$CD8indbyclust & !object_SCT$CD4indbyclust))
           )
object_SCT$ind.method <- ifelse(object_SCT$CD8ind == TRUE & object_SCT$CD4ind == FALSE, "cd8",
                                  ifelse(object_SCT$CD8ind == FALSE & object_SCT$CD4ind == TRUE, "cd4",
                                         "unknown"))
object_SCT$clust.method <- ifelse(object_SCT$CD8indbyclust == TRUE & object_SCT$CD4indbyclust == FALSE, "cd8",
                                    ifelse(object_SCT$CD8indbyclust == FALSE & object_SCT$CD4indbyclust == TRUE, "cd4",
                                           "unknown"))
write.csv(rt1, file.path(batch_dir, "seurat/rt1_rootpath.csv"))
write.csv(rt2, file.path(batch_dir, "seurat/rt2_rootpath.csv"))
object_SCT$CD8ind <- NULL
object_SCT$CD4ind <- NULL
object_SCT$CD8indbyclust <- NULL
object_SCT$CD4indbyclust <- NULL
rm(rt1, rt2, extraCD4, extraCD8)
```

Add 'celltype' annotations based on the consensus between pdfCluster (ind.method) and scGate output.

object_SCT$celltype <- "unknown"
object_SCT$celltype <- ifelse(object_SCT$ind.method == "cd4" & object_SCT$scGate_multi == "CD4T", "cd4", object_SCT$celltype)
object_SCT$celltype <- ifelse(object_SCT$ind.method == "cd8" & object_SCT$scGate_multi == "CD8T", "cd8", object_SCT$celltype)

rm(g1, g2)

Rescue CD4/CD8 T-cell identities for T cells harboring the tested TCRs in the library.

```{r}
object_SCT_sub <- object_SCT@meta.data %>%
  filter(celltype == "unknown" & !is.na(id)) %>%
  mutate(
    celltype = case_when(
      (CD4_mag >= 0.25 & CD8A_mag <= 0.5) | grepl("CD4T", scGate_multi) ~ "cd4",
      (CD8A_mag >= 0.5 & CD4_mag <= 0.25) | grepl("CD8T", scGate_multi) ~ "cd8",
      TRUE ~ "unknown"
    )
  )
# Manual correction.
cells_to_fix <- c("post2_bulk2_AAACCTGAGGTGACCA-1", "post2_bulk3_TGCGTGGGTCACTTCC-1")
object_SCT_sub[cells_to_fix, "celltype"] <- "cd8"
object_SCT_sub <- object_SCT_sub %>% select(celltype)
matching_cells <- intersect(rownames(object_SCT@meta.data), rownames(object_SCT_sub))
object_SCT@meta.data[matching_cells, "celltype"] <- object_SCT_sub[matching_cells, "celltype"]
object_SCT <- subset(object_SCT, subset = celltype != "unknown")
```
